title: Reverse Accountability Search Index
mission: Matrix Reprogrammed is a public accountability system where anyone can search a consequence, trace it backwards through decisions, authority and money, follow the unanswered questions, and return to see what actually happened.
publicPromise: Search the consequence. Trace the power. Follow the outcome.
operatingRule: A match is a route into potentially relevant public records. It is not proof that a named person or institution caused the consequence, exercised authority or benefited.

records.title: Convicted Drug Trafficker Sentenced for Violating Federal Controlled Substances Act
records.consequenceSummary: NEW ORLEANS, LOUISIANA – YILEI ZHOU , age 36, a Chinese national, was sentenced today by United States District Judge Greg G. Guidry to 24 months’ imprisonment, 4 years of supervised release, and a $100.00 mandatory special assessment fee, after previously pleading guilty to conspiracy to distribute, and possess with intent to distribute, a mixture and substance containing one hundred (100) kilograms or more of a detectable amount of marijuana, in violation of Title 21, United States Code, Sections 841(a)(1), 841(b)(1)(B), and 846.
